requirements.title: ATANPI arguments satisfy the source restrictions
requirements.definition: Y shall be real. If Y appears, X shall be real with the same kind type parameter as Y and X shall not be zero when Y is zero. If Y does not appear, X shall be real.

pending.atanpi-y-real-when-present: Positive plan: call ATANPI(Y,X) with real nonzero Y and X; wrong-type Y remains a non-diagnostic source-control mutation.
pending.atanpi-x-real-without-y: Positive plan: call one-argument ATANPI(X) with X initialized to a nonzero real sentinel value; wrong-type X remains a non-diagnostic source-control mutation.
pending.atanpi-x-same-kind-as-y-when-y-present: Positive plan: call two-argument ATANPI with X and Y of the same selected real kind and assert the result kind equals KIND(X); a different-kind source mutation is not a diagnostic oracle.
pending.atanpi-not-both-zero-when-y-zero: Positive plan: exercise the two-argument form with Y==0 and nonzero X, plus a nonzero-Y control; do not claim a required diagnostic for Y==0,X==0.

requirements.title: ATANPI two-argument result matches ATAN2PI and one-argument result is half-revolution-valued
requirements.definition: If Y appears, ATANPI(Y,X) has the same result as ATAN2PI(Y,X). If Y does not appear, ATANPI(X) approximates the arc tangent of X, is expressed in half-revolutions, and lies in the range -0.5 through 0.5.

pending.atanpi-two-argument-same-as-atan2pi: Concrete plan: compute ATANPI(Y,X) and ATAN2PI(Y,X) for the same sentinel-initialized same-kind real inputs with nonzero X/Y and assert equality between the two processor results, not a fixed half-revolution angle.
pending.atanpi-one-argument-half-revolution-rang: Concrete plan: call one-argument ATANPI(X) for initialized finite X values such as -1.0, 0.0, and 1.0, store into a sentinel, and assert only membership in [-0.5, 0.5].
